errors.error_description: Removed the terminating semicolon from a localparam declaration, creating a malformed declaration.
Used logical AND (&&) between a 1-bit enable and a multi-bit vector (addr), which collapses the vector to a single truth value and misuses logical vs bitwise operations.
Drove the same net (conflict0) with two continuous assignments from different sources, creating multiple active drivers.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments within the same always_ff block by assigning valid_r with blocking while dec_out_r uses non-blocking.
